eligibility.explanation: The packet reports experimental delivery of FAP-targeted CAR mRNA in an antibody-targeted LNP, with macrophage-relevant in vivo evidence and linked liver-fibrosis outcomes in mice.

np_ratio.missing_reason: No N/P ratio reported in the packet.

composition.value: LNP-FAPCAR lipid composition (ionizable lipid:DSPC:cholesterol:PEG-lipid = 45:30:23.5:1.5 molar ratio) with anti-mouse CD163 antibody conjugated to the LNP surface

composition_basis.value: Lipid molar ratio; antibody surface conjugation

np_ratio.missing_reason: No N/P ratio reported in the packet.

amount.missing_reason: No antibody amount for this formulation was reported.

amount_unit.missing_reason: No antibody amount unit was reported.

assay.value: histology, Sirius red staining, and Masson's trichrome staining

outcome_value.missing_reason: No numeric fibrosis outcome value was reported in the packet.

outcome_unit.missing_reason: No numeric fibrosis outcome unit was reported in the packet.

qualitative_outcome.value: Treatment with αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR significantly alleviated liver fibrosis.

assay.value: single-cell RNA sequencing and immunofluorescence colocalization

endpoint.value: amount of FAP+ macrophages in fibrotic livers

outcome_value.missing_reason: No numeric FAP+ macrophage outcome value was reported in the packet.

outcome_unit.missing_reason: No numeric FAP+ macrophage outcome unit was reported in the packet.

qualitative_outcome.value: αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR treatment markedly attenuated FAP+ macrophages; FAP/F4/80 double-positive macrophages were virtually eradicated after administration.

unresolved_items: The packet identifies hepatic macrophages and a SAM-like KC cluster but does not establish that all delivery-recipient macrophages were Kupffer cells.
The 45:30:23.5:1.5 lipid ratio is reported for the lipid mixture; the packet does not separately quantify the post-inserted DSPE-PEG-maleimide or antibody contribution in αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR.
No N/P ratio or numerical efficacy values for the reported fibrosis and macrophage outcomes were provided in the packet.
